---
name: Feature idea
about: Suggest a feature or improvement.
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: sumt7
---

**The problem you noticed**
What was missing, confusing, or harder than it needed to be.

**What might help**
A specific suggestion. Half-baked is fine — the conversation is the point.

**Severity tier this would affect (if any)**
Flat / Heavy / Drowning / Dangerous, or "all".

**Anything that would make it a no**
If you can think of why this is a bad idea, list it. Helps avoid going in circles later.
